paragraphs: I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role advertised on SEEK. I read on your website that CCYE does fit-out and cladding work from its own metal and joinery factories, and the ad describes estimating, tender documentation and document control on façade drawings for graduates with up to two years' experience. Cost estimates and bills of quantities were part of my coursework, so that is where I would start.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities, risk registers, and reviewing and preparing technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. Before the diploma I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered structural principles and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records, site reports and progress reports, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors. Keeping those records straight is the closest I have come to document control.

Where I fall short of the ad: I have no façade experience and no work experience in Australia yet, I have not used Aconex or Procore, I use Excel for everyday spreadsheets rather than modelling, and my degree is from 2019 rather than this year, though my Australian qualification is. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the estimating work and what a graduate's first months would look like.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to Sydney: the letter and email say "open to discussing relocation to Sydney". If the answer is no, do not apply.

The ad asks for Professional Engineer in Training status or willingness to pursue it, and for strong Excel skills. The letter says your Excel is everyday use, not modelling. Decide your real answers before applying.
Get your academic transcripts ready: the ad asks for CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter. Attach the BSCE and Advanced Diploma transcripts with the two PDFs from this record.
Paste the screening answers above and fill the notice placeholder.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "SEEK".
notes: CCYE (ccye.com.au, Rhodes NSW) is a plasterboard, cladding and joinery fit-out subcontractor (NSW licence class Dry Plasterer), not an engineering consultancy; the SEEK "civil/structural engineering team" wording is classification language. The role is graduate estimating and document control on façade drawings, 0 to 2 years, recent graduates encouraged. Fit lowered to 62 for the industry mismatch; Marc decides whether a fit-out estimating start suits him. The ad's "Professional Engineer in Training status or willingness to pursue" is left to Marc. No published contact beyond info@ccye.com.au (not stated to take applications), so SEEK is the only route. Interstate: Sydney relocation is Marc's call.
